sentences.text: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption seeks views on corruption risks in funding non-government organisations to deliver human services.
sentences.support: the purpose of the paper is to examine the corruption risks in the funding arrangements

sentences.text: Its research draws on stakeholder discussions, published reports, agency documents and funding systems in other jurisdictions.
sentences.support: examination of unpublished documents of the Commission and government agencies

sentences.text: The Commission identifies tensions between central controls and flexible local delivery, and examines agency structures, provider relationships and wider coordination.
sentences.support: The centrally planned and directed programmatic arrangements of the in-house model do not easily coexist
sentences.section: 1.2 The difficult task of controlling funds

sentences.text: It invites submissions on control arrangements to inform a future position paper that may propose changes to funding management.
sentences.support: The Commission is seeking submissions on the issues raised in this paper to inform the publication of a future position paper.

notes: Consultation paper with 37 discussion questions, not adopted recommendations or investigation findings. No separately headed summary; the reported allegations are omitted.
